:::{#exm-ciid}
#### The usual regression assumption

In @exm-cident, if the $Y_i$ are also conditionally independent given all the doses,
and each $Y_i$ depends on the doses only through its own $X_i$,
then $Y_i \mid X_i\ \ciid$,
and the joint conditional PMF is
$\prodin{\prob(x_i)^{y_i}\paren{1 - \prob(x_i)}^{1 - y_i}}$:
one shared function evaluated at each $(x_i, y_i)$.

:::
